## InvoiceRouter Odoo Production Bulk v2.1.0

One workflow and one workbook support single-account canary, pilot bulk, and production bulk. Enable only tested provider rows. email_list Status updates per job. Safe retry remains on the original account after side effects; pre-side-effect failure may fail over to another Enabled account in the same Failover_Group.

const text = (value) => value === undefined || value === null ? '' : String(value);
const boolText = (value) => { if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return ''; if (typeof value === 'boolean') return String(value); return String(['true', '1', 'yes', 'on', 'requested'].includes(String(value).trim().toLowerCase())); };
const jsonText = (value) => value === undefined || value === null ? '' : JSON.stringify(value);

return items.map((item) => {
  const management = item.json.management ?? {};
  const writeback = management.statusWriteback ?? {};
  const values = writeback.values ?? {};
  const standardStatus = item.json.standardStatus ?? {};
  const key = writeback.key ?? values.idempotencyKey ?? values.requestId ?? standardStatus.requestId ?? '';
  const managedAt = values.managedAt ?? management.managedAt ?? new Date().toISOString();

  return {
    json: {
      writeback_key: text(key),
      writeback_action: text(writeback.action ?? 'UPSERT'),
      writeback_target: text(writeback.target ?? 'invoice_results'),
      key_mode: text(writeback.keyMode ?? ''),
      request_id: text(values.requestId),
      transaction_id: text(values.transactionId),
      idempotency_key: text(values.idempotencyKey),
      job_id: text(values.jobId),
      campaign_id: text(values.campaignId),
      provider_id: text(values.providerId),
      profile_id: text(values.profileId),
      account_id: text(values.accountId),
      action_id: text(values.actionId),
      worker_id: text(values.workerId),
      recipient_email: text(values.recipientEmail),
      workflow_state: text(values.workflowState),
      result: text(values.result),
      invoice_status: text(values.invoiceStatus),
      provider_status: text(values.providerStatus),
      transport_status: text(values.transportStatus),
      provider_customer_id: text(values.providerCustomerId),
      customer_status: text(values.customerStatus),
      post_status: text(values.postStatus),
      email_send_requested: boolText(values.emailSendRequested),
      email_send_status: text(values.emailSendStatus),
      email_send_method: text(values.emailSendMethod),
      email_error_message: text(values.emailErrorMessage),
      email_evidence: jsonText(values.emailEvidence),
      lifecycle_outcome: text(values.lifecycleOutcome),
      lifecycle_failed_step: text(values.lifecycleFailedStep),
      lifecycle_checkpoint: jsonText(values.lifecycleCheckpoint),
      retry_resume_stage: text(values.retryResumeStage),
      retry_resume: jsonText(values.retryResume),
      provider_invoice_id: text(values.providerInvoiceId),
      invoice_number: text(values.invoiceNumber),
      invoice_url: text(values.invoiceUrl),
      pdf_url: text(values.pdfUrl),
      http_status: text(values.httpStatus),
      error_type: text(values.errorType),
      error_category: text(values.errorCategory),
      error_severity: text(values.errorSeverity),
      error_code: text(values.errorCode),
      error_message: text(values.errorMessage),
      retry_scheduled: boolText(values.retryScheduled),
      failover_scheduled: boolText(management.failoverScheduled),
      recipient_status: text(management.workflowResult?.recipientStatus),
      provider_operational_status: text(management.workflowResult?.providerOperationalStatus),
      retry_count: text(values.retryCount),
      retry_delay_seconds: text(values.retryDelaySeconds),
      retry_decision_source: text(values.retryDecisionSource),
      retry_decision_reason: text(values.retryDecisionReason),
      retry_after_seconds: text(values.retryAfterSeconds),
      retry_delay_hint_seconds: text(values.retryDelayHintSeconds),
      next_retry_at: text(values.nextRetryAt),
      lifecycle_mode: text(values.lifecycleMode),
      lifecycle_steps: text(values.lifecycleSteps),
      provider_recipe_id: text(values.providerRecipeId),
      preset_self_check_mode: text(values.presetSelfCheckMode),
      preset_self_check_approved: boolText(values.presetSelfCheckApproved),
      preset_self_check: jsonText(values.presetSelfCheck),
      activation_mode: text(values.activationMode),
      activation_approved: boolText(values.activationApproved),
      activation_safety: jsonText(values.activationSafety),
      bulk_run_id: text(values.bulkRunId),
      bulk_item_number: text(values.bulkItemNumber),
      bulk_total_items: text(values.bulkTotalItems),
      bulk_decision: text(values.bulkDecision),
      bulk_safety: jsonText(values.bulkSafety),
      bulk_summary: jsonText(management.bulkSummary),
      retryable_by_policy: boolText(values.retryableByPolicy),
      non_retryable_by_policy: boolText(values.nonRetryableByPolicy),
      duplicate_prevention: jsonText(values.duplicatePrevention),
      checked_at: text(values.checkedAt),
      managed_at: text(managedAt),
      updated_at: text(managedAt),
    },
    pairedItem: item.pairedItem,
  };
});
